name: sparse-table
description: Static range minimum/maximum query structure with O(N log N) build time and O(1) query time.
aiPromptContext: Use this block for read-only arrays where you need repeated range min/max queries at O(1) each, such as RMQ problems, range GCD, or static histogram analysis.

parameters.name: array
parameters.description: The static input array of numbers to build the sparse table over.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Either 'min' or 'max', determines whether queries return the minimum or maximum over a range.
